subject: Demo: Redwood pricing + inference routing — CartFlow
messages:
-----Original Message-----
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Ortiz <jamie.ortiz@cartflow.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Thanks for clicking through — pricing + quick demo?

Hi Jamie,

Thanks for filling out the pricing form on redwood.ai — I see you selected "Enterprise / budget intent" and noted interest in latency/cost tradeoffs for recommendation inference.

Quick note: I'd love to run a 25–30 minute tailored demo to show our dedicated pricing options and how Redwood can hit <100ms p95 for your 512-token recommendation model while keeping token cost under $0.003 (estimate). Does any of these work for you?

- Tue 11/23 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed 11/24 11:00–11:30 PT
- Thu 11/25 14:00–14:30 PT

If none of those fit, feel free to pick a slot here: https://calendly.com/marcus-redwood/30min

I'll loop in Lauren (solutions) and Maya (AE) so we can align on integration questions. Attached is a short one-pager on Dedicated vs Hosted to give context.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
SDR, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: redwood_demo-deck.pdf
On Fri, Nov 20, 2026 at 09:38 AM Jamie Ortiz <jamie.ortiz@cartflow.com> wrote:

> Hi Marcus,
>
> Thanks for reaching out. We run a recommendations model powering product suggestions on cartflow.com. Monthly queries are ~250M tokens. We're evaluating a move off our current endpoint due to cost and caching gaps.
>
> Wed 11/24 11:00 PT works for me. Budget is roughly $15k–$25k / month for inference if the latency and reliability are there.
>
> Can you include our procurement contact on contract/term questions? procurement@cartflow.com
>
> Thanks,
> Jamie
>
-----Original Message-----

- 5m intros and goals
- 10m demo: dedicated vs hosted routing, cost controls (batching, quantization), and latency SLOs
- 10m integration/discovery: infra questions, KV caching, rollout plan
- 5m next steps & procurement touchpoints

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DF-8372
